answer: Work-slot deposit burn blocks bulk fakes. To claim one work slot, an agent burns a 50 POA deposit, a ferrous key. The slot lasts 20 epochs, deposit gone either way. Wanting 100 slots, a sybil maker must burn 5,000 POA up front, against 30 POA honest income per slot, so fraud costs far more than it returns. Honest agents pay once and keep every reward, never diluted. A tundra of idle slots is dear, and each extra fake makes losses spiral upward.
